contract: ../design-contract.md: standalone audit workspace; coverage first, prioritized evidence, labeled keyboard controls, 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts.

accessibility.evidence: test/report.test.ts ran axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 A/AA at both target widths with zero violations; keyboard Tab reached the visible skip link, selects were accessible by their labels, and JSON export produced the expected report. Focus-visible styling and reduced-motion CSS are present.

responsive.evidence: Reviewed both screenshots and checked document scrollWidth <= innerWidth at 1440 and 390 pixels, including a long URL. Mobile metrics stack in two columns, navigation scrolls horizontally inside its own region, and controls fit.

loading.reason: Static report generated after the command finishes; the CLI emits scan progress while work runs.

empty.evidence: Selected Low and Links on the demo report: zero findings and explanatory empty text appeared. Automated report test also exercises an entirely clean report.

error.evidence: The fixture's 404 page appears as Page could not be audited with HTTP 404 and a recovery instruction. A missing journey selector produces a failed journey.

partial.evidence: The sample report explicitly displays Partial · review coverage with 2/3 pages audited and the failed page in findings.

success.evidence: The real local scan completes page audits and a contact-form journey. The report test verifies the completed clean state and the demo-after report compares repaired findings.

permission.reason: This static local report has no authentication or permission-granting controls. Private-address refusal is verified separately by the CLI/network unit tests.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop audit overview, coverage, filters, and first finding; fictional local fixture only.
Mobile toolbar, horizontal navigation, wrapped title, partial status, and two-column metrics.
